loadout.name: Mystery Loadout
loadout.desc:
Contains a random tiered loadout with mostly premium items and gear. All loadouts are randomly generated and corelate by rarity, meaning scav loadouts will generate mostly scav gear with an added chance that gear and items can upgrade tiers for added randomness. Same with all tiers of loadout.  which means you will never recieve the same loadout twice.  Items unboxed include:
 Weapon, Extra Magazines, Ammo, Grenades, Armor, Rig, Helmet, Headset, Backpack, Food, Drink, and Medical Supplies.

premium_loadout.name: Premium Mystery Loadout
premium_loadout.desc:
Containes a high-tier loadout with mostly premium items and gear. All loadouts are randomly generated and corelate by rarity, meaning high-tier loadouts will generate mostly rare gear with an added chance that gear and items can be downgraded to average tier for added randomness. All tiers of loadout can have some items and gear go up or down rarities as well.  which means you will never recieve the same loadout twice.  Items unboxed include:
 Weapon, Extra Magazines, Ammo, Grenades, Armor, Rig, Helmet, Headset, Backpack, Food, Drink, and Medical Supplies.
